rules: Mean uses training mean;naive uses last observed target.
Seasonal naive repeats last observed seasonal cycle;h>m indexes the final cycle,not nonexistent future values.
Drift extrapolates endpoint change divided by T-1;T>=2 required.
Additive y=trend+season+remainder versus multiplicative product;STL uses LOESS and can be robust.
Centered moving averages and full-series seasonal adjustment can leak;fit only training prefixes for forecasts.
SES level=alpha*y+(1-alpha)*previous level;flat future forecasts. Initial level is part of convention,not an interchangeable library default.
Holt adds trend;damped Holt uses phi powers. Holt-Winters additive/multiplicative seasonality differ;do not mix gamma with gamma*=gamma/(1-alpha).
ETS supplies explicit error/trend/season state-space models and intervals;SSE-level smoothing alone is not a complete fitted ETS distribution.
Likelihood/AICc model selection uses training only;different initial states and optimizers can produce different numerical outputs.
ARIMA(p,d,q),seasonal(P,D,Q)m require stationarity/differencing conventions and residual checks.
MLE and AICc order selection are training procedures;AICc across different differencing orders is not directly comparable.
Fable constants and drift differ by model order/library;default auto search,stepwise and approximation options must be named.
Ljung-Box/residual bias/ACF assess model errors;white residuals do not prove future accuracy.
Forecast errors on held-out data differ from training residuals.
Rolling origin restricts each fit to earlier observations and evaluates relevant multi-step horizons.
Normal/residual-bootstrap intervals need explicit assumptions;coverage must be measured,not inferred from nominal labels.

evaluation_protocol.status: Frozen audit design before any model comparison;not an executable profile
evaluation_protocol.frequency: calendar month,period YYYY-MM;no invented timezone offset for monthly labels
evaluation_protocol.window: Expanding from2000-01;at each origin only periods<=origin may be fitted/used. Refit after earlier outcomes resolve is allowed under frozen selection policy;no tuning on test outcomes.
evaluation_protocol.selection: Freeze candidate set,initialization,hyperparameters,tie order and metrics before validation. Select on validation macro MAE;retrain through2020-12 for first test origin. Later refits keep model family/hyperparameters fixed. Report every planned candidate/failure,not only winner.
evaluation_protocol.transforms: Identity on ppm by default. Any optional scaler/transform/imputer/decomposition fitted separately on each training prefix and serialized. Never center a rolling feature using future rows,globally normalize or decompose the complete dataset.
evaluation_protocol.missing: Require a complete regular monthly grid;duplicates,out-of-order and irregular labels reject. Missing target outcomes remain unscored with denominators;do not use future interpolation/backfill. First bounded models reject missing training values,with later causal imputation separately named.
evaluation_protocol.features: If tree/neural routes added:shift before rolling;label availability,not row index alone,governs training. Direct h-step labels must be fully observed by fold origin;purge unobserved label windows. Recursive h>1 inputs use earlier predictions,not actual future targets.
evaluation_protocol.covariates: None in initial benchmark. Calendar month is known future. Other future covariates require as-of availability references;observed future weather/prices are forbidden. Past-only covariates cannot be passed as known future.
evaluation_protocol.multi_series: Initial dataset has one series. Additional series require group-aware temporal splits;linked/revised targets and cross-series batches must have common as-of cutoff. Disable Chronos cross_learning until independently evaluated;pin batch grouping when enabled.
evaluation_protocol.availability: NOAA file is a revised2026snapshot,not archived publication vintages. Monthly means are corrected by the provider toward midmonth using seasonal-cycle information. This supports retrospective fixed-series held-out evaluation,not a certified leakage-free historical real-time replay. Missing historical release times/revisions are unresolved;prospective skill claims require as-of vintages or new prospective observations.
evaluation_protocol.pretraining: Chronos card lists chronos_datasets/GiftEvalPretrain;exact overlap with NOAA or other benchmarks not excluded. No claim that a frozen test period is unseen by model pretraining.
evaluation_protocol.dependence: 25 origins x12h=300 cells per partition/model but only36distinct target months. Report all denominators and horizon-wise results;overlapping forecast errors are dependent,no independent-trial or significance claim.
evaluation_protocol.candidate_convention: Proposed finite CPU set for the subsequent implementation. SES starts level at first training observation,then consumes subsequent observations with fixed alpha;no SSE/MLE optimization or fitted ETS distribution claimed. Lowest validation MAE wins;exact ties use the listed order. Core fixtures/conventions still must be committed before production.
evaluation_protocol.optional_distributional_request: If a later verified Chronos adapter is included,request native0.05,0.1,0.5,0.9,0.95quantiles,horizon12,record point functional=median. No interval generation or adapter in this audit.

default: paired seasonal-naive MAE difference and ratio when denominator nonzero

formulas.sMAPE_FPP3: mean(200*abs(y-yhat)/(y+yhat));source warns unstable and can be negative,not recommended
formulas.optional_absolute_sMAPE: mean(200*abs(y-yhat)/(|y|+|yhat|));different editorial convention,double-zero term0 with explicit count
formulas.quantile_score_FPP3: 2*((1-p)*(q-y) if y<q else p*(y-q));twice common pinball
formulas.coverage: count(lower<=y<=upper)/N,with nominal level and interval width
formulas.CRPS: Integral of FPP3 twice-pinball over probability;finite quantile grid only gives a named approximation,not exact CRPS

metric_conventions.aggregation: Per-model,origin,horizon and series errors retained. Macro average per series and micro average per forecast cell named separately;common eligibility only for paired comparisons. Report missing/failure denominators and time/memory costs.
